profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Frontend & Growth | React, TypeScript, GraphQL | ex-Netflix, Google & Microsoft
profile.summary:
I’m a frontend-focused software engineer who likes building things people actually use, and figuring out whether we made them better. At Netflix, I led acquisition and retention work from early research and technical design through A/B testing and rollout, with annual revenue impact in the tens of millions. My work spans React, TypeScript, GraphQL, accessible UI and shared frontend architecture.
Before Netflix, I built Google Cloud experiences, was a founding engineer on SharePoint spaces through its global launch, and founded Audiotica in Puerto Rico, a music app that reached 1M downloads. I enjoy mentoring engineers, working closely with design and research, and helping teams use AI thoughtfully. I’m looking for senior or staff frontend and product engineering roles where I can lead technical work and keep coding. I also bring mobile and full-stack experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth & Retention
positions.description:
Built acquisition and retention experiences using React, TypeScript, GraphQL and server-side rendering. Hands-on engineer and technical lead from research and product specs through experimentation and rollout.
• Led a three-engineer team through a three-quarter plan-selection program, including a 14-cell A/B test with three responsive, accessible layouts. Used device-level analysis to advocate mobile-first follow-ups; the winning layout increased total revenue by 0.57%, delivering tens of millions in annual impact.
• Designed and built a lightweight router that decoupled GraphQL migration from a server-driven UI rewrite. Three other engineering teams adopted the approach, enabling UI experiments alongside backend migrations; later standardized by the platform team.
• Built a Slack bot generating test cases from product specs and adapted an open-source dictation app to Netflix’s model gateway. Drove AI adoption across my team and sibling teams through demos and knowledge sharing.
• Led cancellation experiments with $38M in annualized revenue impact, and co-led pause improvements that increased retention by approximately 0.2 percentage points at 98 days.
• Led a two-engineer redesign of logged-out title pages, negotiating scope with product and design to ship accessible, browser-compatible experiences in two months. Winning variants increased sign-up conversion.
• Built plan-change MFA across legacy and modern UI stacks, standardizing a pattern reused across account pages; the experiment reduced unauthorized plan changes by 49%.
Mentored new-grad and mid-level engineers into project-lead responsibilities. Gave org-wide talks on mental health and working sustainably with AI.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, MarTech
positions.description:
Built tools that helped marketing teams promote Netflix titles around the world.

• Built the UI for Netflix Posting Tool, a rewrite of the social publishing platform supporting bulk post creation from CSV files, validation and scheduling. Delivered in about eight weeks.
• Handled urgent production fixes while on call, supporting marketing teams ahead of global title launches.
• Modernized legacy marketing apps and later retired them, decommissioning infrastructure and documenting operational procedures in the team runbook.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3, GCP
positions.description:
Built account and billing experiences in the Google Cloud console.

• Built a shared component adopted by multiple teams to unify page scoping. Closed accessibility gaps and reduced page load time by 3% across a dozen pages.
• Partnered with Payments to expand document center access to previously ineligible users.
• Co-founded a student outreach committee for underrepresented schools through HOLA, Google’s Latinx employee resource group, and spoke on diversity panels.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, SharePoint spaces
positions.description:
Founding engineer on SharePoint spaces, bringing browser-based 3D and VR experiences to the workplace using TypeScript, React and WebVR/WebXR. Helped take the product from rapid prototype through V1 global launch.
• Designed and implemented the 3D extension architecture, reusing SharePoint’s existing authoring tools, search and content infrastructure through new API layers.
• Created Nucleus3D, the framework used by around 15 engineers to build first-, second- and third-party components through launch and beyond. Owned and evolved the third-party SDK.
• Onboarded frontend engineers to 3D development and worked with Fortune 500 customers through user research, demos and technical presentations.
• Named inventor on several 3D and VR patents.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, ODSP Mobile
positions.description: Transitional period while the incubation team would become a product team. Worked on the SharePoint on Android team, bringing new social features to the app.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, Project Hiro
positions.description: Incubated what would later become SharePoint Spaces. Developed prototype on Unity.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, ODSP Mobile
positions.description: I was in charge of getting OneDrive to work on Xbox using UWP codebase. Worked on v1 for SharePoint on Windows.

positions.title: Founder/CTO
positions.description:
Founded an open-source music app integrating Spotify, Last.fm and SoundCloud APIs. Reached 300,000 downloads in its first year and 1M total, generating $100K+ in annual revenue through advertising and subscriptions.
Built the UWP app and ASP.NET backend, including Stripe integration. Reached the top 10 in the Windows Store’s music category.

positions.title: Self Employed
positions.description: Making and publishing apps for Windows Phone.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Interned with Microsoft partner to develop/support custom Windows Phone apps. Customers included El Nuevo Dia (newspaper) and iGen Apps. Worked within local Microsoft office.

honors.title: Microsoft Most Valuable Professional (MVP)
honors.description: Second year in a row that I have been awarded the MVP award.

honors.title: Microsoft Most Valuable Professional (MVP)
honors.description: Recognized by Microsoft for exceptional technical expertise and a talent for sharing knowledge within their technical community.

volunteerExperiences.description:
#SHE_BUILDS is an international platform that exists to accelerate social, economic, & environmental progress in Haiti by equipping entrepreneurs and innovators with the tools to scale their impact.

As a fellow Caribbean, it was an honor to help out fellow islanders with their innovative ideas!
